instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On a sunny paved walkway next to a bridge railing, the man with blonde-tipped dreadlocks (R1) wearing a plaid shirt, white t-shirt, and blue jeans leans forward on the left, holding a pink skateboard. Beside him on the right, the woman with blonde hair (R2) wearing a black leather jacket and black dress walks forward. They hold hands, his left hand in her right hand, moving together in unison under a clear blue sky with bright, direct daylight.
